texts: # Curated memory
## Travel
- For overnight flights, Mira prefers an aisle seat away from the lavatory.
- During Berlin visits, Mira stays at the Lindenhof Hotel near the east station.
- The luggage service booking reference is 48392017.
## Project Atlas
- The Atlas migration owner is Devon Chen; questions about the cutover go to Devon.
- Atlas production cutover is scheduled for 2026-11-08 at 02:00 UTC.
- Atlas staging listens on TCP port 7419.
## Finance
- Invoices from Northstar Hosting map to account 6210 for the synthetic Acorn account.
- Blue Finch Studio invoices are due forty-five days after their issue date.
- The bookkeeping export code for Blue Finch Studio is BF-029184.
## Accessibility
- Sam needs captions enabled for every remote meeting because speech alone is difficult to follow.
- Sam prefers reduced motion and no autoplaying animations in the dashboard.
- Use the high-contrast interface theme for Sam during screen sharing.
## Incident response
- For a stalled Oriole import, pause its scheduler before retrying the failed batch once.
- If the Oriole import fails twice, escalate to the data platform on-call instead of retrying again.
- The synthetic Oriole outage incident number is 90715264.
## Food preferences
- Priya is vegan and does not eat honey.
- Priya drinks decaffeinated coffee after noon.
- Priya is allergic to cashews.
## Release process
- The Juniper release checklist requires a canary deployment followed by a fifteen-minute error-rate check.
- Taylor is responsible for approving Juniper production releases.
- The synthetic Juniper rollback reference is release-2037-amber.
## Support routing
- A customer unable to export their records gets priority two unless data is being lost.
- The North team covers support from 07:00 to 15:00 UTC on weekdays.
- Support queue ticket 58273016 belongs to the North team.
## Short facts
- TZ: UTC.
- Locale: de-AT.
- Size: XS.
## Cedar deadline: 2026-10-19
- Cedar is coordinated by Ada.
## Birch status: CANCELLED
- Do not schedule further Birch work.
## Warehouse pickup code: 61820473
- Show the code at reception.

### Project: github.com/example/beta

<!-- openclaw-memory-promotion:memory:beta -->
- Beta deployment uses region eu-north-1.
- Alpha deployment uses region us-west-2.
## Personal preference
- Replies in German.
## Fire exit: north stairwell

## Retention policy
The synthetic archive keeps exports for fourteen days and then removes them.
